theme: Light theme preferred for corporate accounting workflows to maximize data density, readability, and clarity. A dark mode toggle can be provided but light mode is the default.

headings.usage: Use for all dashboard headers, page titles, widget titles, and modal headers.

body.usage: Use for all tabular data, input fields, financial figures, budget allocations, and general body copy.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Color is for function only.
Use Primary Red (#D32F2F) strictly for key actions (e.g., Submit RAB, Approve, Add Plan) to create a subtle brand connection to Auto2000, while maintaining a stark data-driven UI.
Use Success/Warning/Danger colors explicitly for budget status indicators (Overbudget = Danger, On-track = Success, Pending = Warning).
Never use pure black or grey; neutral greys are slightly tinted (slate).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Use flat solid backgrounds with sharp 1px borders (border-border). Dashboard widgets should be clean cards without heavy drop shadows. On hover, interactive cards can have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow-md.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas to prevent visual refraction. Use flat solid surfaces. For a sticky header, you may apply backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a 1px border-b.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for crisp, technical, professional dashboard iconography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for all form inputs, data tables, dialogs/modals, selects, and dropdowns.
Customize Shadcn Tabs to have h-auto instead of the fixed h-9 class.
Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for budget proportion visualization (e.g., a Donut chart showing 30% Flight, 50% Hotel, 20% Transport).
Use Sonner for all toast notifications (e.g., 'RAB Submitted', 'Approval Successful').
Ensure all interactive elements and key workflow actions have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-rab-button').
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdown menus or modals. They must have a solid surface background.
Implement clear multi-step form structures for the Pra-STO trip planning and budget allocation process.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics).
grids_and_layouts.layout: Sidebar navigation (collapsible for focus) with a top header containing breadcrumbs, role indicator, and user profile.
grids_and_layouts.grid: Main content area uses a responsive grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) between widgets for data correlation. Use generous padding (p-6) inside card containers to allow financial data to breathe.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align all data tables, form labels, and financial figures for optimal reading. Right-align numerical amounts in tables where appropriate.

motion.interactions: Minimalist. Focus on micro-interactions for feedback.
motion.page_transitions: Use staggered fade-in animations (framer-motion) for dashboard widgets upon initial load to soften the dense UI.
rules: Do not use 'transition-all'. Explicitly declare properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all UI animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text against the primary red background meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Secondary text must clearly stand out from the background.
accessibility.focus: Apply focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:outline-none on all inputs and buttons to support keyboard navigation.
accessibility.testing: All key elements must include semantic data-testid attributes.

images.description: User profile avatar for Secretary or Coordinator roles.
User profile avatar for Manager, SPV, or PIC Accounting roles.
Subtle corporate building background for the Auth/Login screen.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Apply the Swiss High-Contrast theme rigorously.
Never center align the entire app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Do not use AI emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use provided image URLs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
Ensure role-based dashboard states are clearly separated (PIC vs Coordinator vs Manager).
